title: Huawei nova 16 SE debuts with an 8,500mAh battery and 6.84-inch display
description: As promised, Huawei has officially unveiled the latest addition to its nova 16 series in China. The nova 16 SE packs a large 8,500mAh battery and comes with a bright display with a claimed 8,000 nits peak brightness. The Huawei nova 16 SE features a 6.84-inch AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate. It is powered by the Kirin 8020 chipset and is available with up to 512GB of onboard storage. title: Realme 16x India launch set for next week, 7,000mAh battery confirmed
description: Rumors surfaced late last month that the Realme 16x would soon launch in India. Realme has now confirmed when the smartphone will make its debut. The Realme 16x will launch in India on August 12. The company has also listed the smartphone on its official India website, revealing several of its key specifications. Realme has confirmed that the Indian variant will pack a 7,000mAh battery with support for 45W fast charging. title: iQOO Z11 confirmed to debut in India on August 20
description: The iQOO Z11 debuted in China in March before expanding to select global markets in May. Several months later, the smartphone is finally headed to India, albeit with a different design and hardware. In a post on X, the company confirmed that the iQOO Z11 will launch in India on August 20. The company also revealed the phone's design, which differs significantly from the Chinese and Malaysian variants. The Indian Z11 features a Pixel-style horizontal camera bar housing dual rear cameras and an LED flash, replacing the camera module seen on the other versions. The Indian variant...

description: Indian handset maker Lava is set to make its UK debut soon with the Agni 4N, which it has been teasing for over a week now by taking constant digs at Samsung. The brand has posted one more teaser, which is yet another dig at the South Korean company. The teaser video posted by Lava UK on its X account gives us a glimpse of the Lava Agni 4N while also confirming the metal build. The smartphone has a horizontally aligned camera island on the rear like the Agni 4, with the right side frame featuring the volume rocker and power button. description: Redmi has revealed more details about the K100 Pro ahead of its launch next week. The company has already confirmed that the handset will be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V chipset and feature a 6.59-inch display. In a new post on Weibo, Redmi confirmed that the K100 Pro will feature a triple rear camera setup headlined by a 200MP primary sensor with OIS. The rear camera system will also include an ultrawide camera and a telephoto sensor with support for 10cm macro photography. description: Technically, Google only releases one major Android version per year – this year it was Android 17. Yesterday, Google rolled out Android 17 QPR 1 Beta 8 to Pixels and now Android QPR 2 Beta 2. Strangely, the release notes make no mention of what has changed since QPR 2 Beta 1. title: Nothing launches CMF Clip Pro earbuds with a Smart Dial on the case
description: Just as expected, today Nothing has unveiled the CMF Clip Pro earbuds. As the name implies, these are clip-style or clip-on earbuds, a category that didn't exist a few years ago but has been gaining popularity recently. These have 10.8mm drivers with "Ultra Bass Technology", and the company advertises 10 hours of music playback and 6.5 hours of talk time from each bud's 60mAh battery. description: Yesterday we heard that Oppo is already working on the F35 family, which would be launching in India in the next few weeks. Today a new rumor from the same source claims that the series is actually getting official before the end of this month. While it's still unclear how many members the F35 family will have, new details about the F35 Pro have emerged. Apparently, it will be a rebranded A7 Pro Max, which just launched in China today. title: ZTE Blade A35e gets listed with confusing specs
description: The ZTE Blade A35 launched all the way back in 2024, which is also when a Blade A35e was spotted in a certification listing. We're not sure what's happened to it since then, but now a Blade A35e that looks very different has appeared on ZTE's official website for Pakistan. Unfortunately, the company hasn't revealed its full specs, only a few tidbits here and there. The phone has a 6.52-inch screen, an 8MP main camera, 64GB of storage, and a 5,000 mAh battery. title: Amazon Prime Video will support Samsung's HDR10+ Advanced
description: Amazon's Prime Video streaming service will be the first one to use Samsung's newest HDR10+ Advanced format on "supported titles globally" beginning later this month. You will need a Samsung TV from the Korean company’s 2026 lineup to take advantage of the new format. As the name implies, HDR10+ Advanced is an upgrade to the HDR10+ format. It brings Enhanced Overall Brightness, which uses extended statistical metadata to "make fuller use of today's premium TV brightness capabilities, delivering brighter, more precise HDR across the full tonal range", the official press release...

title: Google Health finally supports two-way health data syncing with Apple Health
description: When Google launched its new Fitbit Air devices, the company announced a somewhat surprising new feature that lets you import Apple Health data recorded by your Apple Watch and other HealthKit-connected apps and devices. A long-requested feature since 2014 when Apple Health first launched. However, syncing your data the other way remained impossible until now. With the new version of Google Health for iOS (5.05), your Fitbit data can finally be stored in your Apple Health account. Two-way syncing is finally a thing. Workout history, sleep, vitals, steps and all kinds of Fitbit...

description: Good night, sweet prince – OnePlus is officially out of the US market. On July 16, the company made the initial announcement that it will be exiting the North American and European markets. And now the last OnePlus phone has been sold via oneplus.com. The OnePlus 15 and OnePlus 15R are both out of stock on the official site. The site is now pretty barren – there are no more tablets, no smartwatches either. title: Apple to add cross-device clipboard syncing between iPhone and Windows in the EU
description: Windows PC users in the EU could soon be able to copy and paste content directly to and from an iPhone, thanks to a new interoperability feature Apple is developing. The feature was requested by Microsoft through Apple's EU Interoperability Request system. Apple began working on the request in March this year and submitted a proposed implementation plan in June. Microsoft's Phone Link on iOS (Credit - Microsoft) The feature would let users copy text and other supported content on an iPhone and paste it onto a Windows PC, with the reverse also supported. title: Samsung offers no cost EMI for the Galaxy Z Fold8, Z Fold8 Ultra, and Z Flip8 in India
description: Samsung has introduced No Cost EMI financing for buyers of its latest foldables in India. Eligible customers can spread the cost over up to 18 months without paying interest or making a down payment, as Samsung covers the financing charges. The Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra starts at INR 11,111 per month for 18 months (INR 199,999 for the 12/256GB model). It's available in Violet Shadow, Graphite, Cream, and the online-exclusive Green Shadow, with 12/512GB and 16GB/1TB versions also on offer.
